login.description: The Trade Desk email. It is a part of the login credentials.

partners.description: Specific Partner IDs to sync.  Must be populated if `syncMode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

password.description: The Trade Desk password. It is a part of the login credentials.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of data you'd like to include in your initial sync. Increasing this value does not automatically backfill older data for tables that have already synced; trigger a resync for those tables to apply the new time frame. Default value: `THREE`.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
